lead: A `live_bytes` balance taken across a thread's first `[]` is off by one `ArrayHeader`.
body: `nvs_array_new` hands out a per-thread singleton, so the first call on a thread allocates a header that is never freed, and a balance test outside `nvs-runtime` running compiled code reads it as a leak. Call `nvs_runtime::prime_empty_array()` before `let before = live_bytes()`.
